content.title: What channel is Team USA vs Dominican Republic on in World Baseball Classic?
content.text: March 15, 2026Updated March 17, 2026, 4:49 p.m. CTTournament play headlines are quite common in the third month of the year, but usually we're talking about a sport played indoors in fall and winter.But tonight, baseball shares some of the spotlight in March with college basketball. And the game being played is likely to produce some serious offensive madness. It's a true all-star game for the ages.Two of the best batting orders ever assembled clash when the United States and Dominican Republic meet tonight in the semifinals of the World Baseball Classic. Both rosters have nine players that received votes in the most valuable player race last year.Led by Juan Soto and Vladimir Guerrero Jr., the Dominican Republic has outscored its opponents 41-10 in five WBC games. That includes a 10-0 rout of South Korea in the quarterfinals.Pittsburgh Pirates ace and 2025 Cy Young Award winner Paul Skenes will attempt to slow down the Dominican Republic's dangerous attack. He can throw as many as 80 pitches tonight before manager Mark DeRosa needs to turn to a reliever.Brewers second baseman Brice Turang has been one of the top offensive players for Team USA. He's 7-for-15 with four doubles in the tournament. Chicago Cubs centerfielder Pete Crow-Armstrong has also been a surprise with five hits and a pair of homers.Brewers closer Abner Uribe could end up pitching the ninth inning for the Dominican Republic if his team has the lead. However, he has not been sharp in two games, walking three batters and giving up a run.If the U.S advances to the championship game March 17, it will play the winner of the Italy-Venezuela game set for Tuesday, March 17.Here's how to watch tonight's game:What time does the World Baseball Classic start tonight? Team USA vs Dominican Republic start timeTime: 7 p.m. CTDate: Sunday, March 15Team USA's semifinal game in the World Baseball Classic is at 7 p.m. Sunday, March 15, at loanDepot Park in Miami.Team USA baseball vs Dominican Republic TV, live stream: World Baseball Classic how to watchTV: FS1Live stream: Fubo and the ESPN+ Fox One BundleTeam USA starting lineup vs Dominican Republic, World Baseball ClassicTurang continues to hit eighth in DeRosa's lineup. The one notable change in the batting order is Gunnar Henderson hitting fifth instead of Alex Bregman.Who is the starting pitcher for Team USA tonight?Pittsburgh starter Paul Skenes is scheduled to take the ball against the Dominican RepublicIs the game on Sirius radio?Yes, the game is available on channel 89.When does Team USA play next and who is its next opponent?If Team USA defeats the Dominican Republic in the semifinals, it will play the winner of the Venezuela/Italy game Tuesday, March 17, at 7 p.m in Miami.Our team of savvy editors independently handpicks all recommendations.
